title: Compliance Rule
description: Schema for a single rule in legal_metrology_rules.json or fssai_rules.json. Derived from the project's existing descriptive schema.json.

rule_id.description: Unique identifier, e.g. LM-CH2-R6-02 or FSS-R4-01

domain.description: Which legal domain this rule belongs to

description.description: Plain-language summary of what this rule requires

applicability.description: Applicability conditions. Preferred format is an object with commodity_category, package_type, and exemption_conditions. A plain string is also accepted for rules where the applicability is a simple description.

commodity_category.description: Which commodity categories this rule applies to

evaluator_type.description: Which evaluator to use for this rule

expected_value_or_format.description: Exact requirement text used by the rule engine to check extracted data

effective_from.description: Date in DD.MM.YYYY or DD-MM-YYYY format, or NOT_FOUND_IN_SOURCE

effective_to.description: Date, null (still in force), or NOT_FOUND_IN_SOURCE

capability.description: Added by the engine. Optional in source data; defaults to BEST_EFFORT if missing.
